reroute_reason: The delivered bundle was clearly mis-routed: for a question asking the settlement flow, messages and timing of a cross-CSD DvP (ICP seller at Monte Titoli, buyer at another T2S CSD, direct link, EUR, R2026.JUN), it returned only t2s_hold_release_process and t2s_linked_instructions (each duplicated for entity Milan and entity T2S) plus milan_connectivity_and_static_data and milan_xtrm_lifecycle_maintenance. The retriever appears to have read 'direct link' as linked instructions. topic-index.json lists a dedicated route for exactly this question - question_type cross_csd_message_flow (entity Milan, current, required_context release, sections t2s-messages/t2s-posting/t2s-realignment) - and context_vocabulary records cross_csd_message_flow_supported_only_for {release R2026.JUN, access_model ICP, currency EUR, link_model direct-both-in-T2S}, which matches the question word for word. No message, realignment, matching, finality, schedule or cut-off route had been retrieved at all. I used the single permitted routing correction to request 16 contexts, all listed in topic-index.json: cross_csd_message_flow (as_of 2026-09-13 with release R2026.JUN, access_model ICP, currency EUR, link_model direct-both-in-T2S), realignment_mechanism, finality, milan_cross_csd_rule, milan_cross_csd_link_guide, milan_connectivity_and_static_data, milan_xtrm_lifecycle_maintenance, t2s_message_sese023_scope, t2s_message_sese024_usages, t2s_allegement_rules, t2s_status_model, t2s_hold_release_process, t2s_linked_instructions, t2s_baseline_schedule, t2s_partial_windows_and_cutoffs, t2s_partial_settlement. Each as_of was set to the route's latest_review_date so no retrieval would return needs_refresh. All 16 returned evidence_only over 18 sections; no invented question type, entity, date or release was used.
notes: Deterministic checker: 9/9 passed on the first run; no fix iteration required. All 18 retrieved sections are cited; uncited_retrieved is empty. IMPORTANT PROCESS DISCLOSURE: the reroute produced a bundle whose rendered form in prompt.user.md exceeded bundle_for_prompt's 160,000-character cap, so the rendering ends with the marker 'BUNDLE TRUNCATED AT 160000 CHARACTERS' after retrieval 12; retrievals 13-16 (t2s_linked_instructions, t2s_baseline_schedule, t2s_partial_windows_and_cutoffs, t2s_partial_settlement, all evidence_only) and the tail of the hold/release excerpt were not rendered. Because the routing correction is allowed only once per case, I did not re-run the retriever with a trimmed context list. Instead I read those four retrievals' excerpts from this case's own bundle.json - the identical retrieval output the checker validates against, not new or wider evidence - and I disclosed this prominently in the answer (a Rendering note near the top, row 8.18 of the open dependencies and item 10 of Open items). Nothing omitted from the rendering was inferred. Other deliberate handling choices: (1) every clock time written (18:45, 20:00, 16:00, 08:00-08:30 etc.) comes verbatim from the retrieved schedule and RTS sections and is labelled as the nominal R2026.JUN baseline in CET, explicitly not an appointment and not a Monte Titoli participant deadline, since no dated event overlay and no Milan timetable were retrieved; (2) matching is kept separate from settlement throughout - SF1/SF2/SF3 from Milan Articles 72(1)-(3) with the Article 70(2) bilateral-cancellation reservation attached to SF2, and the sese.032 realignment notifications described as created instructions rather than completed ledger movements; (3) the question's phrase 'direct link' is flagged as not a category the retrieved T2S text certifies - the evidence defines issuer-type and investor-type CSD links flagged default or alternative - and the assumed model (ICP/EUR/direct-both-in-T2S) is stated as the condition under which this evidence selection is admitted; (4) the realignment-failure path (erroneous links or accounts configuration causes T2S to cancel the inbound instruction) is called out as the route's principal failure mode; (5) the double-negative printed modification condition in the Milan Instructions section 3.4.7 A is quoted verbatim and my reading labelled Reasoned inference, with a warning that the Italian text prevails; (6) the inference that T2S-generated realignment links do not automatically bar partial settlement is explicitly labelled an inference from two passages and flagged as unconfirmed because Table 71 is not admitted; (7) no field cardinalities, XML, reason codes or status values are stated, since the sese.023 business-rules table, the MyStandards schema, the reason-code catalogue and the status transition diagrams are all not admitted. Italian governing language, translation status, approval qualification and both review dates are carried on the citations and restated in Open items.
